crossRefs.note: The elders of his house arose beside him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, and he didn’t eat bread…
Men won’t break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead. Men won’t give them the cup of consolation to…
Sigh, but not aloud. Make no mourning for the dead. Bind your headdress on you, and put your sandals on your feet.…
You will do as I have done. You won’t cover your lips or eat mourner’s bread.
God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him;
Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death…
They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of Yahweh, and for…
Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or anything else, until the sun goes down.”
translations.bsb: Then all the people came and urged David to eat something while it was still day, but David took an oath, saying, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!”
translations.kjv: And when all the people came to cause ➔ David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
translations.asv: And all the people came to cause David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David sware, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or aught else, till the sun be down.
